ValidationRule.description: When a child case is created, this ensures that a follow up is entered upon case create.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $RecordType.Name = "NAS General Support Case", OR( ISBLANK(Follow_up_Date__c), ISBLANK(Text(NAS_Pending_Reason__c)) ), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, "On Hold - Customer"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "On Hold - Internal") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please add a Follow Up Date and Pending Reason when placing case On Hold.
